% Pattern: head/section. A head written by hand that only opens a part of
% the paper, as {\bf Acknowledgements.} or \paragraph{Summary.}, is not an
% item. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\begin{document}
\section{One}

\begin{theorem}
Every bounded monotone sequence converges.
\end{theorem}

\paragraph{Summary.} We showed that monotone bounded sequences converge.

{\bf Acknowledgements.} The author thanks the referee for helpful comments.
\end{document}
